campi_del_mandato.instrument: Laboratory tray 275x210 mm, layer 50 mm; HPGe 80000 s for Ra-226
campi_del_mandato.missing_values: Emanation NOT measured here: read off a Strong & Levins 1982 graph, f = 0.079-0.28. Values extracted from figure vector geometry.

sampling_frequency.motivo: moisture curve: one point per moisture level, not a time series

campi_del_mandato.site: Weathered granite soil, central Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan, laboratory tray
campi_del_mandato.soil_properties: Ra-226 57.0 and Ra-224 55.8 Bq/kg; density 1730 kg/m3; porosity 0.30
campi_del_mandato.split: Exploratory only: the emanation is not measured, so a flux comparison would test an assumption, not the model.
campi_del_mandato.units: Moisture percent by mass; exhalation mBq/m2/s

note: The Richards step is not robust on this configuration at millimetric cells (audit section 26): the correct protocol freezes the water field, and with it the model matches the slab solution to 1-2%.
